content.short: Moongate enables Web2 and Web3 brands to issue smart tokens for engagement.
content.description: Online attention is a scarce resource in a crowded digital landscape, where traditional ad models struggle to compete. Direct Value Issuance (DVI) rewards users directly for their attention, aligning incentives for both brands and audiences. Crypto enables smart tokens that drive attention. Moongate's Protocol makes it easy for Web2 and Web3 brands to create, issue, and manage these assets, enabling campaigns built around audience rewards.
content.meta: Moongate is an attention asset protocol for issuing smart tokens to engage audiences. Discover Moongate and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
